act.long_title: An Act to consolidate, define and amend the law of Evidence.

licence: Published with commentary and other original matter under s.52(1)(q)(ii), Copyright Act 1957.

section.heading: Proof of documents by production of certified copies
section.html: Such certified copies may be produced in proof of the contents of the public documents or parts of the public documents of which they purport to be copies.
section.text: Such certified copies may be produced in proof of the contents of the public documents or parts of the public documents of which they purport to be copies.
